videos.title: The Sound of Music Live!
videos.description: A stage version of the Rodgers and Hammerstein musical, originally broadcast live. A novice nun leaves her convent to accept a position as governess to a large family.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: During a sunny suburban summer before the Second World War, Mr Klausner develops a box which amplifies the tiniest sound, even recording the screams of flowers as they are being cut.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: Buddies Sim and Bob arrive at the house of their friend Dr David Rankin, but they are convinced that a doctor has buried his wife in the cellar.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: Harry's integrity and hard work have earned him a promotion at the bank. Despite his immaculate accounts, Harry is accused of embezzlement. His honestly might be too good to be true.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: Kyros Kassoulas decides to pay a fortune for a bottle of wine and then invite the man he suspects of having an affair with his wife over for dinner.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: A cunning woman who attempts to take advantage of a struggling young artist meets her match in his model, Fatima.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Hour
videos.description: An actor threatened by Satan worshippers agrees to star in a new film as long as no one knows where he goes upon leaving the studio each day.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Hour
videos.description: A frightened embezzler (Steven Hill) stages his own suicide with the help of his double-crossing girlfriend (Joanna Moore).

videos.title: Opry Live
videos.description: In celebration of Don Williams, Keith Urban, Trisha Yearwood, John Foster and Rodney Crowell bring live country music to the Grand Ole Opry stage.

videos.title: West Side Story
videos.description: Against a backdrop of vicious gang warfare between the New Yorker Jets and the Puerto Rican Sharks, a romance develops across rival lines. 1960s update of 'Romeo and Juliet', with amazing song and dance sequences.

videos.title: Portrait Artist of the Year
videos.description: Nine artists have four hours to paint entrepreneur Deborah Meaden, opera singer Danielle de Niese or author Jung Chang.

videos.title: Classic Albums
videos.description: Revealing how Elvis created his seminal debut, which caused a sensation in 1956, with Sam Phillips, Keith Richards, and BB King among those discussing the album and its far-reaching influence.

videos.title: Johnny Cash: Man in Black in Britain
videos.description: Exploring the connection Johnny Cash shared with Britain. Features testimony from those who were closest to him, from his own children to friend Elvis Costello, and celebrity fans including Jools Holland and Freddie Flintoff.

videos.title: Johnny Cash: A Night to Remember
videos.description: Footage from Johnny Cash's 1973 performance at the Ahmanson Theatre in Los Angeles; a preview of "The Man in Black in Britain.".

videos.title: Billy Joel: Live from Rome
videos.description: Songs from this 2006 concert taking place in front of the Roman Colosseum include "My Life," "Just the Way You Are," "New York State of Mind," "Uptown Girl," "Allentown," "Scenes From an Italian Restaurant" and "Piano Man.".

videos.title: Tom Petty Live at The Olympic
videos.description: Join Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers for a live performance of The Last DJ, alongside classic hits, recorded in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Greatest Albums Live
videos.description: Guitar icon Peter Frampton had huge success with his best-selling rock album 'Frampton Comes Alive!' in the 1970s, and performs hits from it at the Tucker Theatre in Tennessee.

videos.title: Johnson & Knopfler's Music Legends
videos.description: Brian and Mark head to Nashville, Tennessee, to meet up with Mark's longtime friend and sometime collaborator, Emmylou Harris, who shares her career highlights and discusses her relationship with legendary country rock pioneer Gram Parsons. Along the way, the trio are joined for a jam session with country music guitarist Vince Gill.

videos.title: Discovering Music
videos.description: Music experts explore the legacy of Jethro Tull, one of the most commercially successful and eccentric progressive-rock bands Britain has ever produced.

videos.title: Black Sabbath: Paranoid (Classic Album)
videos.description: The story behind the writing, recording, and success of Black Sabbath's legendary second studio album 'Paranoid', which featured the hit songs 'War Pigs', 'Iron Man', and the title track.

videos.title: Gene Kelly: An American in Hollywood
videos.description: From his beginnings in cabarets and on Broadway to his recognition as a choreographer and director, the good-looking star with a charming smile expanded the boundaries of dance expression.

videos.title: All Rise: Edinburgh International Festival
videos.description: A celebration of more than 50 years of the legendary Steve Reich's music, including a world premiere performance, from the Usher Hall in Edinburgh.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: A greedy wife has a cunning plan to get rid of her wealthy husband, but he has a few tricks of his own up his sleeve.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: Henpecked Arthur decides to get rid of his demanding wife once and for all, so long as he gets her money. Unfortunately for him, his wife has a few secrets of her own.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: The fine line between love and hate is stretched to breaking point when two old school friends reunite after years apart, as the penniless Emma drags Nell down into poverty with her.

videos.title: Inside The Music
videos.description: The London Philharmonic Orchestra performs Sibelius' celebrated four-movement masterpiece. This captivating orchestral work is renowned for its sunny pastoral themes, dramatic tension and a truly triumphant finale.

videos.title: Apollo 13
videos.description: In 1970, this US spacecraft was on its way to land on the Moon, but things went terrifyingly wrong when an oxygen tank exploded. Unlock the real story behind the headlines.

videos.title: Portrait Artist of the Year
videos.description: Nine artists have four hours to paint entrepreneur Deborah Meaden, opera singer Danielle de Niese or author Jung Chang.

videos.title: The Story Of Panto With Gyles Brandreth
videos.description: Panto aficionado Gyles immerses himself in every aspect of the genre, from its roots in commedia dell'arte and Victorian music hall to scene painting, joined on his merry way by pantomime experts Julian Clary and Gary Wilmot.

videos.title: The Music of Buddy Holly and the Crickets
videos.description: The definitive story of how Texas-born Buddy Holly became an icon of the first generation of rock and roll during his short career, featuring the hits 'That'll Be the Day' and 'Peggy Sue'.

videos.title: Madness: Live At House of Common
videos.description: Ska legends Madness headline the August 2016 House of Common festival at Clapham Common, London, with a set featuring Our House and It Must Be Love.

videos.title: Queen: Champions of the World
videos.description: Tracking the history of Queen's reign, from their humble beginnings to their meteoric rise to their rightful place as the champions of the world.

videos.title: Downhill Racer
videos.description: An aloof ski bum feels inclined to race in the Olympics when the top-ranked skier is injured on the slopes.

videos.title: The Doors Live at the Bowl '68
videos.description: Fronted by Jim Morrison, The Doors performed classic hits in a legendary 1968 concert at the Hollywood Bowl, featuring 'Light My Fire', 'Hello, I Love You', 'Moonlight Drive', and 'The End'.

videos.title: Opry Live
videos.description: Jordan Davis, Hudson Westbrook, Graham Barham, Avery Anna and Emily Ann Roberts bring live country music to the Grand Ole Opry stage.

videos.title: Moody Blues Live at the Isle of Wight
videos.description: Another chance to see footage of the Moody Blues on stage at the Isle of Wight Festival in 1970.
